title: Hamiiid, Haaamid... Hamid?
description: Codeforces problem CF2127B - Hamiiid, Haaamid... Hamid?
expected_approach: Compute nearest walls to the left and right of x (L and R), then answer = max( min(x, n-R+2), min(L+1, n-x+1) )

test_cases.explanation: Mani builds wall at 2; Hamid escapes left immediately.
Wherever Mani places a wall, Hamid escapes opposite side next day.
As shown in the example: optimal plays lead to 3 days.
